title: Spring Cloud Bus Refresh Event
description: Event published to the 'springCloudBus' Kafka topic to trigger a configuration refresh across all subscribed services. Published by Config Server via POST /actuator/busrefresh.

type.description: Spring Cloud Bus event type discriminator.

timestamp.description: Unix epoch milliseconds when the event was published.

originService.description: Eureka appName of the service that triggered the refresh (typically 'config-server').

destinationService.description: Target Eureka appName pattern. '**' broadcasts to all subscribers.

id.description: UUID identifying this specific event instance.
